## Current Site Purpose

- explain who Tymur Rudov is in professional terms;
- connect YouTube, academy, LinkedIn, and selected commercial branches;
- provide clear entry points for learning, consultations, media, and partnership requests.
- host selected long-form white papers that translate maritime practice into reusable frameworks.

## Legacy Recovery Layer
